title: Constructible chart composition mates and coherence of the diagonal arrows
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient conventions [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $\Lambda=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\geq1$. Use constructible exceptional inverse images and derived pullbacks on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the specified Tate twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Write $\omega_g=Rg^!\Lambda$ and $C(g,s)=Ls^*\omega_g$ for a smooth separated finite-type morphism with closed section [def-pur-section-invariant].

Let $U,V$ be affine finite-type $k$-schemes, $P:\mathbf A^d_V\to V$ the standard projection, and $u:U\to\mathbf A^d_V$ an etale $V$-map; put $h=Pu$, where $h$ is smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-sbc-affine-space, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $c_{P,u,\Lambda_V}:Rh^!\Lambda_V\to Ru^!RP^!\Lambda_V$ be the specific constructible composition map defined as the exceptional transpose of $RP_!Ru_!Rh^!\Lambda_V\xrightarrow{\alpha_{P,u}}Rh_!Rh^!\Lambda_V\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_h}\Lambda_V$ [pur9-def-upper-shriek-composition].

This is an isomorphism, and its composite with the canonical etale identification $Ru^!=Lu^*$ gives a counit-preserving isomorphism $\epsilon_u:\omega_h\xrightarrow{\sim}Lu^*\omega_P$. The evaluation is on the stated domain: $K=Rh^!\Lambda_V$ is bounded constructible, has an etale-origin witness, and $Ru_!K$ is bounded below of etale origin [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory, lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin, thm-sf-comp-composition]. Its value is the conjugate of $\alpha_{P,u}$ for the composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction, def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate].

Put $C_g=C(p_g,\Delta_g)$ for $g=h,P$, with $p_g$ the first projection of the self-product, $\alpha_g:C_g\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_g$ the diagonal base-change map [lem-pur-diagonal-base-change], and $C_{N_g}=C(\pi_{N_g},0)$ for the actual normal bundles [def-pur-normal-bundle]. The map $u\times u$ induces, after restricting near the diagonals to make the square of centres Cartesian, the counit-defined section comparison $q_u:C_h\xrightarrow{\sim}Lu^*C_P$. Its normal differential and base change induce $r_u:C_{N_h}\xrightarrow{\sim}Lu^*C_{N_P}$. With $\delta_g$ the normalized DNC map [thm-pur-dnc-invariance] and $\beta_g$ zero-section integration purity [cor-pur-vector-bundle-purity], the actual maps satisfy
$$Lu^*\alpha_P\,q_u=\epsilon_u\alpha_h,\qquad r_u\delta_h=Lu^*\delta_P\,q_u,\qquad Lu^*\beta_P\,r_u=\beta_h.$$
For further open restrictions and composable etale chart maps, these are the same comparisons as those from the pasted diagram; they satisfy the identity and associativity equations, with the canonical pullback and Tate constraints. In particular the identity chart has $\epsilon_1=1$. No orientation choice is an input to $c$, $q_u$, or $r_u$.

proof.text: For the smooth chart projection, ordinary exceptional inverse image preserves bounded constructibility. Transport this along diagonalDualizingComparison to the actual pro-etale omega. Equality of the projection maps gives the result for e followed by the target projection. A bounded constructible object has bounded-below etale origin; compact-support direct image preserves this class.

Apply the counit equation. Its right-hand side epsilon is an isomorphism, as is rho, so composition is an isomorphism by cancellation. Cancel omegaCongr against its inverse in eps to obtain the actual ExceptionalMate equality.
The diagonal source square, normalized chart DNC square, and normal integration square are exactly the three factors in ThreeEquations.

Use epsilon identity and composition. For q, conjugate by alpha: naturality of the canonical pullback identity/composition constraint and the source square cancel the invertible alpha factors, giving q identity and composition. Rewrite the DNC square as r followed by pullback(delta inverse) equals delta inverse followed by q. Apply the same cancellation argument with delta inverse to transfer q identity and composition to r. Assemble the coordinate and arbitrary-map conclusions. No separate geometric q/r pasting theorem is required.

Steps 1-8 are correct; I re-derived each: (1) the Yoneda inverse of the specified c on D^b_c, with the domain from constructible-origin(ii) and thm-sf-comp-composition; (2) eps_u=rho_u c is counit-normalized, and omega_P is invertible so ctf; (3) chart-cartesian-domain with X=U, j=1, used for scheme assertions only, and I checked by hand that s is the base change of Delta_A; (4) the R_i and R_ai hypotheses hold and B_C has the right source and target; (5) the sigma-cocycle third equation with H=P, base h, etale u, then vertical pasting and pullback along Delta_U give Lu*alpha_P q_u = eps_u alpha_h; (6) flat conormal base change plus the Rees difference frame (same hypotheses as the item); (7) the endpoint cancellation with dnc base change; (8) vector-bundle base change, GL_d trace invariance (Noetherian, N=l^r) and the site comparison. FIX 1 (Step 4): E_{ai,t}=Li*E_{a,t}E_{i,p_h} needs associativity of c, which was uncited; I added thm-sf-comp-composition and lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting with the derivation. I rewrote the step as an explicit, checked calculation: w=1xu; E-composition; vertical B pasting; the sigma-cocycle-locality interchange E_w B_{p_h,v}=Lw*B_{t,v} Lb_v*E_{a,t}; pullback along Delta_T. For r: r_u = B_N^{-1}R_{n_u} with n_{uv}=v*n_u n_v. I also corrected eps_{uv}=Lv*eps_u E_{v,h} and added the sigma-cocycle node to the step's uses; the proof_deps set is unchanged. All three are generic foundational facts, not steps of the trace formula or Poincare duality; accepted.
